title: The Marvel/Shonen Jump Partnership Has Bad News For Fans
content: In February of this year, Shueisha made the startling announcement that its publishing partnership with Marvel was coming to an end. What this meant was that on March 31st, no new manga publications would be created, bringing to an end series such as Deadpool: Samurai and putting an end to future potential crossovers.
author: ComicBook

title: 7 New Isekai to Watch This Summer (& Where to Find Them)
content: With the start of July comes a whole new wave of anime as part of the Summer 2026 anime schedule , and that means there are some new Isekai anime releases you’re going to want to keep an eye out for over the next few months.

title: Shueisha Games Announces Wild Wild Eden Open-World Survival Crafting RPG for Steam
content: Shueisha Games and developer Magnus Games Studio revealed on Wednesday the new open-world survival crafting role-playing game Wild Wild Eden , which will launch for early access on Steam in spring 2027. Shueisha Games also started streaming the game's official trailer and gameplay trailer.

title: HBO Max Has Removed One of Its Strangest Anime Originals
content: In the streaming game these days, it can sometimes feel like no movie and/or television series is safe. Aside from properties often playing leapfrog when it comes to platforms, there are unfortunate scenarios where certain projects leave streaming entirely.

title: This Summer 2026 Anime Proves Kagurabachi Could Be 2027’s Most Visually Striking Anime
content: Kagurabachi has become one of the biggest sensations in the anime and manga world, with fans hoping to see an anime adaptation even before the first chapter was released back in 2023. Three years later, an anime adaptation of the series was finally announced, with the anime set to premiere in April 2027.
author: ComicBook

title: Madhouse Reveals 'ghost' Original Anime Film's Teaser, Full Title, February 11, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for Madhouse 's new theatrical anime project, tentatively titled ghost, opened on Wednesday and revealed the film's official title ghost – end of night ( ghost/yoru no hate ), early teaser trailer, first key visual, musical composer, and February 11, 2027 opening in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Soara to Mamono no Ie' Receives TV Anime Adaptation in 2027
content: Production company Kadokawa opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Hidenori Yamaji 's Soara to Mamono no Ie ( Soara and the House of Monsters ) manga on Wednesday, revealing the main cast, staff, an ultra teaser visual (pictured), and ultra teaser promotional video.

title: Eris Begins Her Training in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 1 & Episode 2 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 1 and Episode 2 preview images ahead of their July 5 premiere. Crunchyroll will be streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup . The new season is set to begin with the Eris Training Arc , focusing on her journey after leaving Rudeus behind.
